```{r build-icer-table, include=FALSE}
# Helper to extract ICER display value for a strategy from a model's results
extract_icer_display <- function(result, strategy) {
  icer_df <- as.data.frame(result$icer_obj)
  row <- icer_df[icer_df$Strategy == strategy, ]
  if (nrow(row) == 0) return(NA_character_)

  if (row$Status %in% c("D", "ED")) {
    return("Dominated")
  } else if (!is.na(row$ICER)) {
    return(sprintf("\u20AC%s", format(round(row$ICER), big.mark = ",")))
  } else {
    return("\u2014")
  }
}

# Build wide-format ICER comparison table
biomarker_strategies <- c("crp", "tmb_braf", "tlr")
strategy_labels <- c(
  "crp" = "CRP-guided vs SoC",
  "tmb_braf" = "TMB/BRAF-guided vs SoC",
  "tlr" = "TLR-guided vs SoC"
)

table_5 <- data.frame(
  Strategy = strategy_labels[biomarker_strategies],
  Model_A = sapply(biomarker_strategies, function(s)
    extract_icer_display(all_results$Model_A, s)),
  Model_B = sapply(biomarker_strategies, function(s) {
    if (s == "tlr") return("N/A\u2020")
    extract_icer_display(all_results$Model_B, s)
  }),
  Model_C = sapply(biomarker_strategies, function(s)
    extract_icer_display(all_results$Model_C, s)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  row.names = NULL
)
```

```{r display-table}
kable(table_5,
      caption = "Table 5: ICERs for biomarker-guided strategies across model specifications (\u20AC per QALY, overall MSS population)",
      format = "html",
      col.names = c("Strategy", "Model A", "Model B", "Model C"),
      align = c("l", "r", "r", "r")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 12) %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "SoC = Standard of care.",
      "\u2020TLR excluded from Model B by design.",
      "All biomarker strategies yield fewer QALYs than standard care in Models B and C. In Model A, only TMB/BRAF yields a positive (though very high) ICER; CRP and TLR are dominated.",
      "Model A: comprehensive (all biomarkers, all interactions). Model B: focused (CRP and TMB/BRAF as covariates and interactions, TLR excluded). Model C: single biomarker."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```

```{r save-table, include=FALSE}
tables_dir <- here("tables")
if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) {
  dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Save raw numeric ICER data for all models
save_data <- data.frame(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
for (model_name in names(all_results)) {
  icer_df <- as.data.frame(all_results[[model_name]]$icer_obj)
  icer_df$Model <- model_name
  save_data <- rbind(save_data, icer_df)
}

write.csv(save_data, file = here("tables", "table_5.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Table saved to:", here("tables", "table_5.csv"), "\n")
```

Table 5 has been saved to `tables/table_5.csv`.
